mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle that reduces equity discount rates and boosts forward returns, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 1.5% in a three-month window, it triggers a monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates and reduces forward returns, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5% for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% and rise in federal funds rate above 1.0% signals a tight labor market triggering aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and FEDFUNDS > 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During strong consumer demand regimes (retail sales growth exceeding 0.5% month-over-month), elevated corporate earnings expectations drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tightening labor market that precedes inflationary pressures and monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1100.0 thousand units and drop in industrial production below 100.0 index signals broad economic slowdown, reducing earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1100.0 and INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and rising) with tight labor markets (UNRATE < 4.0%), intensified inflationary pressures cause S&P 500 underperformance, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market tightness
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and UNRATE < 4.0%.
